retention_rules: Retain any visit with a current customer confirmation.
Retain any visit involving an unusable lift, the only step-free exit, evacuation access, or scheduled medical transport, regardless of customer response.
Appointment time alone does not change confirmation or fault severity.
cancellation_rule: Cancel a visit only when the customer has explicitly declined the visit and the event documents a routine, non-operational issue with no access or medical dependency.
execution_rule: List the live calendar before acting, delete only by the exact unique title, then list the calendar again and report the retained and canceled event IDs with their evidence.
